$comment: Common expanded (creditable) withholding tax rates — RR 2-98 as amended by RR 11-2018. Reference table for the employer/withholding-agent surfaces. Draft pending research reconciliation.

value.rate: 5% if annual gross ≤ ₱3M with sworn declaration; 10% otherwise

value.payee: Contractors & subcontractors (incl. security, janitorial, IT services)
Purchases of goods by Top Withholding Agents
Purchases of services by Top Withholding Agents
Income payments to partners of GPPs
TWA purchases of specified goods (fuel, pharma, vehicles) direct from manufacturers/importers
value.rate: 0.5% — preferential rate under RR 24-2025, effective Oct 10, 2025

value.payee: E-marketplace / digital platform remittances to online sellers
value.rate: 1% of one-half of gross remittances (effective 0.5%); exempt if annual gross remittances ≤ ₱500,000 with sworn declaration, or BMBE-registered — RR 16-2023

legalBasis: RR 2-98 Sec 2.57.2, as amended by RR 11-2018
rates.notes: The full ATC schedule is longer; these are the rates MSMEs meet most. Top Withholding Agents: designated by published BIR list — criteria per RR 31-2020 (gross sales/receipts or purchases ≥ ₱12M for Groups A/B, ≥ ₱5M for C/D/E); obligation starts the month after list publication. Individual 5% professional-fee rate requires the payee's sworn declaration (gross ≤ ₱3M, non-VAT); without it, withhold 10%. Lone-payor payees with annual income ≤ ₱250,000 may be exempted by sworn declaration.

sec34kRepealed.value: For taxable years from 2024, an expense is deductible even if the related withholding tax was not withheld or remitted — EOPT repealed NIRC Sec 34(K). The withholding agent remains liable for the unremitted tax, surcharge, and interest.
sec34kRepealed.notes: Major change from the pre-2024 deduction-disallowance regime; verify application with your CPA on first use.

value.deadline: last day of the month following each calendar quarter

legalBasis: NIRC Sec 33, as amended by RA 10963
fringeBenefitsTax.notes: Applies only to fringe benefits given to managerial/supervisory employees (rank-and-file benefits run through compensation instead). Out of the estimator's scope; surfaced on the employer checklist.
